name: Sweep Next-Edit 1.5B
purpose: Sweep states: local next-edit autocomplete that predicts the next code edit before the user makes it; the vendor claims it outperforms models over 4x its size on next-edit benchmarks and runs under 500 ms with speculative decoding on a laptop.

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.notes: Card says Apache 2.0; no LICENSE file; base model Qwen2.5-Coder (Apache-2.0 for the 1.5B size per its own card, not re-read).

architecture.why_this_design: Sweep states the goal: predict the next edit locally in under 500 ms (with speculative decoding) and beat models over 4x its size on next-edit benchmarks; base model Qwen2.5-Coder 1.5B, context 8192.

pc-12gb.notes: estimate from file size against the budget of docs/hardware (12 GB VRAM with 64 GB RAM); dense model, weights must sit in VRAM for speed

pc-16gb.notes: estimate from file size against the budget of docs/hardware (16 GB VRAM with 64 GB RAM (reference)); dense model, weights must sit in VRAM for speed

pc-24gb.notes: estimate from file size against the budget of docs/hardware (24 GB VRAM with 96 GB RAM); dense model, weights must sit in VRAM for speed

pc-32gb.notes: estimate from file size against the budget of docs/hardware (32 GB VRAM with 128 GB RAM); dense model, weights must sit in VRAM for speed

mac-16-24gb.notes: estimate from file size against the budget of docs/hardware (unified memory 16-24 GB, GPU share about 12 GB)

mac-32gb.notes: estimate from file size against the budget of docs/hardware (unified 32 GB, GPU share about 22 GB)

mac-64gb+.notes: estimate from file size against the budget of docs/hardware (unified 64 GB, GPU share about 52 GB)

engine_support.notes: plain qwen2, served by any llama.cpp; Tona's megakernel owns the GPU while it runs (research/52)

strengths: Next-edit prediction from recent diffs, not only fill-in-the-middle
weaknesses: No numbers on the card; claims come from a blog post we did not read
soft.behavior: Prompt combines file context, recent diffs and current state; needs a client that supplies them.

tona_fit.reason: Small purpose model for editor autocomplete next to the coder; see research/52 on GPU switching.

sources.note: page text read through a summarizer (WebFetch)

open_questions: Per-language quality and independent coding evidence: the Aider polyglot board is stale (mirrors: last update 2025-11-20, no entry for any model of this database), LiveCodeBench and swebench.com publish no per-language numbers for it that we could retrieve. Check: our own Exercism polyglot run per language.
